thinking_toggleable.description: False when the model always reasons: a thinking switch would do nothing.

warning.description:
Why the action may be slow, when the runtime noted something (a Metal
load larger than the host memory macOS reports available).

error.description: Why the download failed, on an `error` event.

device_fit.description:
Whether the model can load on this device at all: `fits`,
`too_large` (it needs more memory than loads here are planned
against) or `unknown`. Other loaded models may still have to make
room for one that fits.

disk_required_bytes.description:
Free disk a download of the model needs: its files, plus the
checkpoint a `.nemo` archive unpacks on first load. 0 once
downloaded.

display_name.description: Human-readable model name from the catalog.

estimated_memory_bytes.description:
Memory the model needs to load, in bytes: the catalog's estimate,
which is all there is before the model is downloaded.

estimated_size_bytes.description: Expected download size from the catalog, for models not yet on disk.

license_notice.description:
What the weights' licence permits, when the label alone does not
say it (Fish Audio Drama 3: free for research and non-commercial
use, commercial use only below USD 500k annual revenue, and a hosted
service needs a licence from Fish Audio). Informational: nothing is
refused on it.

memory_required_gb.description: Catalog estimate of memory needed to run the model, in GB.

pinned.description:
Explicitly loaded in this session: survives budget and memory-pressure
eviction until explicitly unloaded.

task.description:
Primary task: tts, asr, diarization, chat, forced_align, audio_chat
or tokenizer.

diarization_pipeline_asr.description: The diarization pipeline may use the model as its ASR stage.

keyword_biasing.description: Transcription requests may bias recognition with `keywords`.

native_word_timestamps.description: Word timestamps come from the model itself (no forced aligner).

one_model_diarization.description:
Diarization jobs may name the model alone: it transcribes, tags
speakers and times words itself, with no pipeline ASR or aligner.

speaker_attributed_asr.description: Speaker-attributed ASR jobs: the model writes speaker turns itself.

speech_translation.description: Transcription requests may ask for a translation (`target_language`).

removed_models.description:
Downloads of variants whose support was removed, still on disk. They
are never deleted automatically; `DELETE /v1/admin/models/{variant}`
with the listed `variant` reclaims the space.

residency.description: Residency snapshot for the `ollama ps`-style observability surface.

AdminRemovedModelInfo.description: A leftover download of a removed variant.

replacement.description: The supported variant to use instead.

model_keep_alive_secs.description: Idle keep-alive for transient residents in seconds (0 = reaper off).

resident_count.description: Models currently tracked as resident (loading or ready).

controls.description:
Model-specific controls a speech request may set, each with its
range and the model's default (Chatterbox: `exaggeration`,
`cfg_weight`, `min_p`).

cross_lingual_reference.description:
Whether a reference voice may name the language it is spoken in
(`reference_language`), as the model clones a voice into another
language (Maya 2 Native).

default_language.description:
The `languages` entry a request without `language` speaks (LFM3
Audio: `en-US`); absent, pickers default to English.

inline_tags.description:
Inline tags the text to speak may carry, as written, each a vocal
event or delivery the model performs where it stands (Maya1:
`<laugh>`, `<sigh>`, …; Maya 2 Native: `[laughs]`, `[sighs]`, …).

inline_tags_strict.description:
Whether a tag `inline_tags` lacks is refused (Maya1); otherwise the
list is a suggestion and other tags pass through.

language_auto_detect.description:
Whether `language` may be left out (or `auto`) and is then read from
the text's script (Maya 2 Native); the picker offers "auto-detect".

languages.description:
The only languages a speech request may name in `language`, for a
model that refuses others (Chatterbox, Maya 2 Native); absent,
`language` is a hint.

max_references.description:
The reference clips a dialogue request may carry; present only with
`supports_speaker_dialogue`.

max_speakers.description:
The speakers a dialogue may voice, numbered from 0; present only
with `supports_speaker_dialogue`.

reference_transcript_required.description:
Whether a reference voice needs its transcript. Every reference
family but Chatterbox conditions on the reference's words; Chatterbox
takes the audio alone.

streaming_mode.description:
What a streaming request delivers on this server (TPIPE-3):
`chunked` (audio as the model commits it) or `unsupported`.

supports_in_progress_replay.description:
Whether an unfinished text-to-speech record of this model can be
played from its start (`GET /v1/text-to-speech/{record_id}/events`):
the server plans the model's speech segments and journals each
segment's audio as it is generated.

supports_seeded_voice.description:
Whether the model speaks without any voice input: with no reference,
the sampling seed sets its voice, so a reference is optional (Fish
Audio Drama 3).

supports_speaker_dialogue.description:
Whether one request may voice several speakers: `<|speaker:N|>`
tags or a `script`, with `references` per speaker (Fish Audio
Drama 3).

AdminStorageResponse.description: Where models are stored and how much room is left there.

free_bytes.description:
Free bytes on the volume holding the models; `None` when it cannot
be read.

alignment_source.description:
`model` when every word was timed by the aligner; `heuristic` when
some windows fell back to evenly spaced timings (see `warnings`).

duration.description: Duration of the aligned audio in seconds.

warnings.description: One entry per alignment window whose timings are not the model's.

content.description: Text, or content parts: `text`, and images for Qwen3.5.

audio.description:
Spoken replies are not offered here (the voice realtime API speaks);
any value is a `400`.

modalities.description: Replies are text: only `["text"]` is accepted.

skip_special_tokens.description: vLLM extension: `false` keeps special tokens in the reply text.

oneOf.description: Engine request phases; absent under strict OpenAI compatibility.

decode_ms.description: Sum of physical batch service time, not wall time.

decode_wall_ms.description: First entered decode dispatch registration to last durable token commit.

skip_special_tokens.description: vLLM extension: `false` keeps special tokens in the reply text.

SpeechDialogueReference.description:
One reference voice of a dialogue request: a clip (`audio`, base64, with
its transcript `text`) or a saved voice, and the speaker it voices.

audio.description: The clip, base64 audio (at most 60 s for Fish Audio Drama 3).

saved_voice_id.description:
A saved voice instead of `audio` and `text`: its clip and
transcript (it must have one).

speaker.description:
The speaker this reference voices, 0 to the model's
`max_speakers - 1`; unset, the speaker of a `<|speaker:N|>` tag that
leads `text`, else 0. A leading tag must name this speaker.

text.description: What the clip says; required with `audio`.

allOf.description:
Model-specific sampling and controls (`top_p`, `seed`, `cfg_weight`,
`exaggeration`, `min_p`, ...); a control the model does not take is
refused.

allow_format_fallback.description: Return WAV for a recognized format this build cannot encode (`aac`).

bitrate.description: Target bitrate in bit/s for mp3 and opus.

input.description:
The text to speak. Fish S2 and Fish Audio Drama 3 refuse text holding
their prompt's control tokens (`<|im_start|>`, `<|im_end|>`,
`<|voice|>`, `<|text|>`, `<|interleave|>`, `<|semantic:N|>`);
performance tags such as `[sighs]` and `<whisper>…</whisper>` pass
through. Long text is split into chunks the model speaks one after
another. Fish Audio Drama 3 voices `<|speaker:0|>` to
`<|speaker:15|>` tags in it as a dialogue. Required unless a
`script` gives the text.

language.description:
A language hint. Fish Audio Drama 3 reads the language from the text
and is not given this; a `[language: xx]` tag in the text steers it.

max_tokens.description:
The output budget in model frames. Fish S2 bounds the whole request
with it; Fish Audio Drama 3 bounds each chunk (1 to 4,096; unset, a
chunk gets about 2.5 times its speaking estimate, at most 1,024).

reference_audio.description:
A reference clip to clone: base64 audio, a data URL, or an http(s)
URL on IZWI_ALLOWED_MEDIA_DOMAINS (`ref_audio` elsewhere). Fish Audio Drama 3 takes one
up to 60 s (saved voices hold 30 s) and speaks in a voice its `seed`
sets when given none.

reference_language.description:
The language the reference audio is spoken in (Maya 2 Native, which
clones across languages); absent, read from the transcript's script.

reference_text.description:
The reference clip's transcript, required with `reference_audio` by
every model that conditions on its words (all but Chatterbox).

references.description:
Reference voices per speaker, for a model that voices several
(`supports_speaker_dialogue`: Fish Audio Drama 3, at most 8, speakers
0 to 15; several may voice one speaker). Each is a clip (`audio` and
its `text`) or a `saved_voice_id`. Replaces `reference_audio`,
`reference_text` and `saved_voice_id` (giving both is a 400); a
speaker without a reference speaks in a voice its `seed` sets. Inline
clips total at most 16 MiB; use saved voices beyond that.

response_format.description:
`mp3`, `opus` (Ogg), `flac`, `wav`, `pcm` (OpenAI's: 24 kHz PCM16),
`pcm_i16` / `pcm_f32` (the model's rate), `g711_ulaw`, `g711_alaw`.
`aac` is refused: AAC encoders need a patent licence. The default is
IZWI_SPEECH_DEFAULT_FORMAT (`wav`).

sample_rate.description:
The rate to encode at (resampled when the model's differs); opus
takes 8000/12000/16000/24000/48000, mp3 its MPEG rates.

script.description:
A dialogue as lines, each spoken as `<|speaker:N|> text`, the lines
joined by newlines; replaces `input` (giving both is a 400). Models
with `supports_speaker_dialogue` only.

service_tier.description:
Izwi extension of OpenAI's field: `flex` runs the request as batch
work behind interactive and streaming requests; `default`, `auto` or
absent keeps the route's own class; `priority` is served as
`default`. The `X-Izwi-Service-Tier` request header is read when the
body names none.

stream_format.description:
`audio`: the encoded file as a chunked body while it is generated;
`sse`: base64 deltas of the same bytes (`speech.audio.delta`).

top_k.description: Top-k sampling. Fish Audio Drama 3 reads 0 as no cap.

voice.description:
A voice name, or OpenAI's custom-voice object `{"id": "..."}` naming
a saved voice (`/v1/audio/voices`). A model that clones and has no
built-in voices reads a name as an uploaded voice's.

SpeechSamplingRequest.description:
Optional speech-sampling fields a request may set beside `temperature`
and `top_k`. Anything left unset keeps the model family's reference
default (TPIPE-24): Qwen3-TTS generation_config, LFM 0.8 / top-k 64,
VibeVoice CFG 1.3 with 10 steps, fish-speech 0.7 / 0.7, Voxtral greedy.

cfg_weight.description:
Classifier-free guidance weight, in [0, 1]; 0 turns guidance off
(Chatterbox; its default is 0.5).

exaggeration.description: Emotion intensity, in [0, 2] (Chatterbox; its default is 0.5).

normalize_text.description:
Speak numbers, currency, dates, times and units as words. Unset keeps
the model's default: on for Kokoro (English) and Maya 2 Native (in the
request's language), off for models that read them themselves.

seed.description:
Sampling seed (Qwen3-TTS, LFM2.5-Audio, Fish S2, Fish Audio Drama 3,
Voxtral noise, Kokoro noise). Fish Audio Drama 3's voice without a
reference comes from it, and chunk i of long text samples from
seed + i.

SpeechScriptLine.description: One line of a dialogue script: a speaker and what they say.

text.description:
The line, without a speaker tag; performance tags such as `[sighs]`
pass through.

keywords.description:
Izwi extension: terms to bias recognition toward, as an array (or
one comma- or newline-separated string). Models without keyword
biasing reject it (400).

response_format.description:
One of json, verbose_json, text, srt, vtt; anything else (including
diarized_json) is rejected with 400 before transcription runs.

service_tier.description:
Izwi extension of OpenAI's field: `flex` runs the request as batch
work behind interactive and streaming requests; `default`, `auto` or
absent keeps the route's own class; `priority` is served as
`default`. The `X-Izwi-Service-Tier` request header is read when the
body names none.

speaker_labels.description:
Izwi extension: tag speakers in the transcript (models that do, such
as Nemotron-3.5-Transcribe-30B-A4B-FP8; others reject it with 400).
verbose_json then carries `speaker_turns`.

keywords.description:
Izwi extension: terms to bias recognition toward. Repeat the field or
separate terms with commas or newlines. Models without keyword
biasing reject it (400).

response_format.description:
One of json, verbose_json, text, srt, vtt; anything else (including
diarized_json) is rejected with 400 before transcription runs.

service_tier.description:
Izwi extension of OpenAI's field: `flex` runs the request as batch
work behind interactive and streaming requests; `default`, `auto` or
absent keeps the route's own class; `priority` is served as
`default`. The `X-Izwi-Service-Tier` request header is read when the
body names none.

speaker_labels.description:
Izwi extension: tag speakers in the transcript (models that do, such
as Nemotron-3.5-Transcribe-30B-A4B-FP8; others reject it with 400).
verbose_json then carries `speaker_turns`.

service_tier.description:
The tier that served the request (`flex` or `default`), when the
request named one.

alignment_windows.description:
Aligner windows the audio was split into (each at most the aligner's
audio limit).

duration.description: Duration of the aligned audio in seconds.

izwi_asr_diagnostics.description:
ASR diagnostics. With word or segment timestamps it also carries
`alignment_source` (model, heuristic or failed), `alignment_warnings`
for windows timed by interval fallback, or `alignment_error`.

service_tier.description:
The tier that served the request (`flex` or `default`), when the
request named one.

speaker_turns.description:
With `speaker_labels`: the model's speaker turns (`speaker` is its
tag, null before the first; `start` and `end` when it timed them).

info.description: Local HTTP API for the Izwi runtime, OpenAI-compatible endpoints, and first-party workflow surfaces.
info.title: Izwi API

get.description: Open the local Scalar API reference UI.
Fetch the bundled Scalar API reference JavaScript asset.

503.description: Inference runtime failed permanently; restart the process

get.description: Fetch the generated OpenAPI document for the local server.

200.description: Server is ready to serve requests

503.description: Server is alive but not ready

get.description: What a verified consent recording says, per language.

200.description: Encoded audio (Content-Type per response_format; a chunked body for stream_format audio), or server-sent audio events for stream_format sse. X-Izwi-Speech-Id names the request for GET /v1/audio/speech/{speech_id}; X-Izwi-Service-Tier names the tier that served it.

post.description: Up to IZWI_TTS_BATCH_MAX_ITEMS speech requests: top-level fields are defaults each of `items` overrides. Returns `{id, object, results[], total, succeeded, failed}`; each result carries base64 `audio_data` or an OpenAI `error` object, and an `id` for `GET /v1/audio/speech/{speech_id}`. A top-level `service_tier` (or the X-Izwi-Service-Tier header) applies to every item: they run as batch work (`flex`) unless it is `default`, `auto` or `priority`. The response names the tier served in X-Izwi-Service-Tier, and in `service_tier` when the request named one.

get.description: Text in, audio out: `session.config`, then `input.text` as text arrives, `input.commit` to speak what is buffered, `input.done` to end the utterance, `input.cancel`, `session.close`. Audio arrives per segment between `audio.start` and `audio.done`. `?dialect=sglang-omni|vllm-omni` serves those stacks' clients.

Status, finish reason, usage, audio duration and timings of a /v1/audio/speech request (any delivery), by its `X-Izwi-Speech-Id`. Process-local and bounded (IZWI_SPEECH_OUTCOME_CAPACITY, IZWI_SPEECH_OUTCOME_TTL_SECS); no audio is kept.

requestBody.description: Transcription input. Send application/json with audio_base64, or multipart/form-data with an audio file or audio_base64 field.

200.description: Transcription result as JSON, verbose JSON, text, SRT, VTT, or server-sent events. X-Izwi-Service-Tier names the tier that served it.

post.description: OpenAI's translation route: multipart `file`, `model` (a model that translates speech: Granite Speech 5.0, Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe), `prompt`, `response_format` (json, text, srt, verbose_json, vtt), `temperature`. The target is English unless `to_language` / `target_language` names another; `language` hints the source; `stream` gives `transcript.text.*` events. `service_tier` (or the X-Izwi-Service-Tier header) works as on transcriptions.

get.description: Consent recordings, newest first; `after` and `limit` (1 to 100) page them.

post.description: Multipart `name`, `recording` (at most 10 MiB) and `language` (BCP 47). Under IZWI_VOICE_CONSENT_MODE=verified the recording must say a consent phrase (GET /v1/audio/consent_phrases).

delete.description: Deletes the recording and revokes every voice made with it.

get.description: A consent recording's metadata and verification.
Every saved voice, as OpenAI `audio.voice` objects in `data` and SGLang-Omni's `voices`/`uploaded_voices`.

post.description: Multipart `name`, `audio_sample` (at most 10 MiB) and `consent` (a consent id from /v1/audio/voice_consents, or an attestation, per IZWI_VOICE_CONSENT_MODE); optional `ref_text`, `reference_language`. Speak it with `voice: {"id": ...}`.

delete.description: Deletes a voice by id (OpenAI) or by name (SGLang-Omni, vLLM-Omni).

get.description: A voice by id or by name.

200.description: Chat completion JSON when stream is false; server-sent events when stream is true
Retrieve a locally available OpenAI-compatible model

get.description: Upgrade to an OpenAI Realtime (GA) session: JSON events with base64 24 kHz PCM16 or G.711 audio. `?model=` selects a realtime profile (a modular ASR, chat and TTS stack, or a speech-to-speech model); OpenAI model names select the default profile. `?intent=transcription` opens a transcription session.
